Method of Attack: Malware installed on ATM's internal computer after physical access to the device
Malware responds to commands entered via the PIN pad or USB keyboard attached to the ATM
Interfacing with ATM's specialized software to issue commands to the cash dispenser component to empty money bill-storage cassette
Replacing ATM's hard-drive with a tainted one containing malware
Using industrial endoscope to press reset button inside ATM
Simple 'press F3 for cash' mode of operation (Ploutus)
Attack Vector: Physical access to ATM's backside to install malware and replace hard-drive
Date of Discovery: First detection in US (date not specified)
